test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is not one of the five basic food groups suggested by the Indian Council of Medical Research?
solution:
The correct answer is**__ __**__**Carbohydrates and Proteins.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Council of Medical Research suggests five basic food groups for a healthy diet.**
 
• **Carbohydrates and Proteins are not **included in the list of** basic food groups suggested by the Indian Council of Medical Research.**
 
• Carbohydrates and Proteins are macronutrients that are essential for a** healthy diet, but they are not considered as a separate food group.**
 
• Consuming a balanced diet that includes all the necessary nutrients in the right proportion is important to maintain good health.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Milk and meat products are rich sources of protein, calcium, and other essential nutrients.
 
• Pulses and legumes are good protein, fiber, and other essential nutrient sources.
 
• Fruits and vegetables are rich sources of vitamins, minerals, and fiber.
 
• Cereals and grains are good sources of carbohydrates, fiber, and other essential nutrients.
